# LiteRtLmDemoAgent

object [LiteRtLmDemoAgent](index.html)

Example agent demonstrating how to use local tools with LiteRT-LM in the Kotlin ADK.

This agent uses [LiteRtLmModel](../../../google-adk-kotlin-litertlm/com.google.adk.kt.litertlm/-lite-rt-lm-model/index.html) as its execution model and has access to local functions defined in [LocalToolService](../-local-tool-service/index.html) via KSP tool generation.
